c.v: port signals to specified pins via GPIO Matrix.
For core0, their names are pro_alonegpio_out0~7.
For core1, their names are core1_gpio_out0~7.

Then you can set certain bits of GPIO_OUT to 1 via instructions EE.WR_MASK_GPIO_OUT and EE.SET_BIT_GPIO_OUT, or set certain bits to 0 via instruction EE.CLR_BIT_GPIO_OUT, so as to pull certain pins to high level or low level.
Using this method, you can get faster response than pulling pins through register configurations.
